name: Geisel Library
provenance: Floor shapes and heights from the campus map's Geisel model; study rooms placed from the UC San Diego Library's floor maps. Bookings come live from the library's LibCal system.

coordinateSystem.description: Meters east (x) and south (z) of the middle of the 6th floor, aligned with the campus map.
coordinateSystem.northNote: Outlines are geographic. Room positions assume the library maps are drawn north-up (see the map sources).
